PHYTO-ESTROGEN FORMULA As women age, the production of hormones changes. During this time, changes in hormone levels may impact physiological changes such as mood swings, hot flashes and night sweats. - Standardized soy isoflavones - Act as mild estrogens and may be helpful in providing support for the discomforts associated with menopause.* Emerging research suggests that isoflavones also have the ability to help maintain bone density.* The most recognizable isoflavones are genistein and daidzein. - Isolase(R) - A patented enzyme system. Laboratory studies indicate that Isolase(R) is able to significantly increase the availability of soy isoflavones.* Isolase(R) provides more than 10 times increase in the key isoflavones Genistein and Daidzein+ +Based on laboratory studies combining 35 mg of Isolase(R) with 100 mg of total isoflavones for 1 hr. The increase in the level of genistein and daidzein in each sample was then measured by high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC). A 12.8 fold increase in genistein and 10.5 fold increase in daidzein were observed. - Black cohosh - A popular herb studied in German clinical trials and frequently recommended for hot flashes.* - Evening primrose oil (EPO) - A natural source of omega-6 fatty acid, gamma-Linolenic acid (GLA). GLA supports hormonal balance and helps to maintain smooth, healthy looking skin.* - Important vitamins and minerals - Including calcium, magnesium and vitamin B-6 and B-12. To ensure a more complete nutritional program, be sure to include one of GNC’s premium Women’s Ultra Mega(R) multivitamin formulas to your daily regimen.
